title: OpenAEV scenario intake request
description: What intake needs beside a platform export to add or update an entry. Threat and sources are checked fully as part of scenario.yaml.

mode.description: new to add an entry, update to replace the scenario.json of an existing one.

external_id.description: The entry's identifier: a new UUID in lower case for a new entry, the entry's own for an update.

domain.description: The catalogue domain of the entry, one of policy/data/domains.yaml.

slug.description: The entry's short name in its domain, in kebab-case.

threat.description: For a new entry: the threat the scenario reproduces, as in scenario.yaml.

sources.description: For a new entry: public sources about the threat, as in scenario.yaml.

generated_by.description: For a new entry: a short label of the tool or pipeline that generated the scenario, if any.

severity.description: The scenario's severity, for an export that has none: it is written in the stored scenario, so the platform imports it, and in scenario.yaml.

category.description: The scenario's category, for an export that has none, written as the severity is.

main_focus.description: The scenario's main focus, for an export that has none, written as the severity is.

issue.description: The number of the issue the pull request closes.

rewrite.description: For an update: true when the scenario was renamed on the platform.

payloads.description: Hints about the payloads the export embeds. Intake checks every one; a hint never decides.

payload_claim.description: A hint about one payload the export embeds, by its name.

name.description: The payload's name as the export holds it.

based_on.description: The payload of the catalogue this one was made from.

payload.description: The slug of a payload of the catalogue.

version.description: The version that was duplicated; the latest when absent.
The version wanted for a new version of the payload; it must be higher than the highest the catalogue holds.
